overall_summary: All four material outcomes are satisfied: each correctly assigned host runs Nginx, listens on TCP 6700, and directly returned HTTP 200 for /. Final lifecycle observations corroborate the listeners and show no failed services or damaged package state.
limitations: HTTP checks originated on each target host and used its managed-node IP; no request from a separate peer was captured.
OpenRC failed-service inventory is unavailable in the fixed lifecycle snapshots, although direct service-status checks showed Nginx started on both Alpine nodes.

operational_hygiene.summary: No failed systemd services, package inconsistency, or abandoned temporary artifacts were observed. However, the default Nginx configuration also left port 80 listening on every node, an unnecessary additional exposure outside the requested port 6700; this is most relevant on the Alpine nodes, where no host firewall command was installed.
